row.notes: Finds the MyTeam career save (Career_Is_MyTeamGameMode predicate) and reads the assigned badge key. If g_Game_MyTeamSetupBadgeKey is valid it just stores the key in g_FeTile_CurrentBadgeKey and the maps at info system +0x110. Otherwise builds a default two-layer badge (texture nodes from +0x1bb8, colours from +0x1d8), adds it with Ent_EntrantsSystem_AddBadge (key at +0x160), stores it, optionally saves the profile and sends a scene request (0x18) with the new key.
